svg.title: F23-3 Meter wiring for a 4-wire wye LV main: three CTs, direct voltage inputs, fused and shorting test block
svg.text: links: open for test, closed for service
S1 of CT1 CT2 CT3 in, I1+ I2+ I3+ out
CT1, CT2, CT3 on L1, L2, L3: 4000/5 A
V1 V2 V3 via 2 A fuses, VN unfused
primary side: P1 towards the transformer
arrow on CT body points to the load; photo on the device record
test block, then meter I+ / I-
continuity S1 to I+, loop resistance, shorting links closed
L1, L2, L3 through 2 A fuses
phase sequence L1-L2-L3 clockwise, fuse rating on the schedule
no fuse in the neutral; 4W-Wye selected in the meter
F23-3 Meter wiring for a 4-wire wye LV main: three CTs, direct voltage inputs, fused and shorting test block

MSC-1 block LV main 3,478 A at 415 V · CT 4000/5 A class 0.2S, 5 VA · voltage inputs V1 V2 V3 VN through 2 A fuses · CT secondaries through a shorting test block · S2 commoned and earthed at one point
• CT ratio 4000/5 A gives 4.35 A secondary at 3,478 A; the meter CT primary setting must be 4000 and secondary 5, wiring mode 4W-Wye (often shown as 4W WYE or 3PH4W).
• An open CT secondary under load produces dangerous voltage: the shorting block is closed before the meter or a lead is disconnected, and S2 is earthed at one point only.
